observations.body: Baal’s prophets call and cut themselves without answer; Elijah repairs the LORD’s altar, drenches the offering, prays, and fire consumes it.
observations.label: Carmel tests which god answers by fire

observations.body: The passage presents divided loyalty, silence, repaired altar, water, prayer, fire, confession, and judgment as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: divided loyalty, silence, repaired altar, water, prayer, fire, confession, and judgment

observations.body: The passage places carmel contest beside divided loyalty, silence, repaired altar, water, prayer, fire, confession, and judgment.

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 18:20–40 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the one-time public contest is not ordinary daily sacrifice
